newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RESEARCH ALERT - Country Rd seen a buy.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RESEARCH ALERT - Country Rd seen a buy.

text.p: Morgan Stockbroking Ltd was recomending international clothing retailer, Country Road Ltd as a strong buy reflecting new growth prospects backed by its new partnership with Japanese fashion giant Itochu Corp.
"A strong buy. With a major international partner to drive growth in the US and Japan, Country Road is due for a rerating in the market," Morgan analyst John Clifford said in a report.
With Itochu agreeing to buy 25 percent of Country Road's US operations, management was now confident of moving to profitability in North America, Clifford said.
"The agreement with Itochu also provides for expansion in Japan with between 25 and 30 outlets expected to be opened over the next five years," he said.
Clifford said the outlook for the group's financial year ended July 31, 1997 was for a continuation of tight trading conditions in Australia, offset by a further reduction in United States' losses.
Clifford forecast current year net profits rising to A$10.7 million from $10.2 million in 1995/96 with a total dividend payout of nine cents a share compared with 8.5 cents previously.
"We believe benefits from the association with Itochu will start to flow through to earnings in 1997/98 as additional stores are opened," Clifford said.
Country Road's balance sheet remained "very conservative" despite an increase in debt during 1996/97 to fund increased working capital and capital expenditure of A$9.2 million.
This financial strength would be beneficial as expansion gathered pace both in the US and Japan, he said.
"We believe the discount applied to Country Road by the market is no longer warranted, given the stronger international outlook," Clifford said. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
